content_html_sanitized:
As always, Real Tested CBD brings you another high-quality brand that is a well-known name in the CBD industry with some innovative products for you and your loved ones. Whether you are looking for a CBD remedy for yourself, seniors, or pets, this brand is one of the best out there, known as cbdMD.

cbdMD is a CBD manufacturer from North Carolina. They are famous for providing a wide CBD product range, including tinctures, CBD capsules, CBD gummies, CBD products for sleep aid, and CBD for pets. We at Real Tested CBD had an opportunity to test a variety of products by cbdMD, and most products seem to be using CBD isolate instead of broad-spectrum or full-spectrum. However, most test results were relatively close to what the label claimed.

Here are our test results of eleven products from cbdMD:

cbdMD’s Premium CBD Gummies

Image Source: RealTestedCBD

These gummies from the cbdMD test slightly above the label claim, but we also found it to be devoid of any other cannabinoids present in broad or full-spectrum distillate. It can only mean that it is a CBD isolate product, or the extraction process for this product was too stringent. It is solvent and pesticide-free and contains 899.58 mg.

Are you a senior looking to learn more about the benefits of CBD and shop reliable products?

cbdMD’s CBD Bath Bomb

Image Source: RealTestedCBD

This novel cbdMD bath bomb holds up to its label claims. However, our lab test found this product to come from broad or full-spectrum distillate as it appears to be devoid of any cannabinoids other than CBD. This product may also be a CBD isolate product. It contains 79.41 mg of CBD per package.

Paw CBD Apple CBD Oil for Horses

Image Source: RealTestedCBD

Do not be confused by the name; Paw CBD Horse oil is still a product by cbdMD. This oil’s levels are significantly above its label claims at more than 1700 mg. It also appears to be a CBD isolate product with CBD levels of whopping 6701.17 mg. It has no signs of pesticides or solvents and is safe for your pet horses.

cbdMD’s CBD Freeze

This muscle freeze cream by cbdMD comes with accurate levels as per the label claim. However, it is devoid of any beneficial cannabinoids such as THC, CBG, CBC or CBN. This indicates that it is a CBD isolate product extracted via astringent extraction method. It does contain a healthy and impressive quantity of CBD that is 1454.4 mg per package and has no traces of solvents or pesticides.

Paw Cbd’s Flavored CBD Oil

This chicken and catnip flavor CBD oil by cbdMD is a tincture for your cats. Our lab test found the label claims to be accurate, but this seems like a CBD isolate product. This tincture contains 354.56 mg of CBD for your feline for relaxation. This product is safe from pesticides and any industrial solvents etc.

Paw CBD’s Peanut Butter CBD Oil

This CBD tincture for dogs by cbdMD is accurate in CBD level claims, which stand at 2730.37 mg per package. Apart from that, it has no other useful cannabinoids and is a CBD isolate product.

Paw CBD Soft Chews

This edible Paw CBD soft chews for cats comes in chicken catnip flavor from cbdMD. It has 373.65 mg of CBD, which comes from CBD isolate; that is why it contains no other cannabinoids. Apart from that, we found no traces of pesticides or solvents.

CBD-Infused Peanut Butter

 

Peanut butter for your canine by cbdMD has an impressive dosage of CBD at 952.66 mg per package. It will give your dog all the CBD goodness required for calming and relaxing effects, but it does not contain any THC, CBC, CBG, or CBN in the mix.

CBD Balm

This Paw CBD balm by cbdMD is a CBD isolate product extracted using an astringent method with no THC, CBC, or CBN. However, it contains CBD levels of 805.38 mg, which are beneficial for your dogs. This is one of the best products for pets by this manufacturer.

cbdMD’s Premium CBD Oil Capsules

This cbdMD capsule is one of the products that under-delivers on its promise of CBD levels. The label claims to have 1500 mg of CBD, whereas our lab results found it to be at only 1,152.82 mg. Additionally, this product claims to be non-GMO, vegan, and gluten-free products. However, it failed our lab tests when tested because it contains pesticides called daminozide. So stay away!

CbdMD’s Premium CBD Oil

This is a premium tincture containing CBD levels below the claimed amount by 75 mg. But it does contain an astonishing amount of CBD dose at 7424.37 mg, which is probably one of the highest doses in any product out there. It is an isolate product with no solvents or pesticides in the mix.
